title: Realme 16x arrives with the Dimensity 6300 SoC, a 144Hz screen, and a 7,000 mAh battery
description: Realme today unveiled the Realme 16x as the newest member of the Realme 16 series. One of the headline features of the Realme 16x is its 7,000 mAh battery with 45W charging support. It also supports all-scenario bypass charging and 6.5W wired reverse charging. Another headline feature of the Realme 16x is its 144Hz LCD, measuring 6.81" diagonally. It has a 1,570x720-pixel resolution, 1,200 nits peak brightness, and is protected by Panda-1681 glass. The Realme 16x is powered by the Dimensity 6300 SoC, paired with up to 6GB of LPDDR4X RAM. title: iOS 27 code confirms six upcoming iPhones
description: Yesterday, Apple released the fifth beta of iOS 27 for developers, and according to a new report, this version contains some hidden code that reveals six upcoming iPhone models. The references in question were found in the system files related to the battery drivers and the Battery Intelligence features. Alongside the existing models, the iOS 27 beta 5 code also mentions the iPhone Air 2 (codenamed V62), the iPhone 18 Pro (V63), the iPhone 18 Pro Max (V64), the iPhone 18 (V67), the iPhone Ultra (V68), and the iPhone 18e (V69). iPhone 17 Pro The codenames align with previous leaks...

title: Lenovo unveils its next gaming tablet's AnTuTu score while a rumor reveals its battery capacity
description: Lenovo is fully unveiling its next gaming tablet on August 25. Ahead of that, today the company has announced its AnTuTu score, and it's very impressive at 4,585,844. The tablet will be called Y700 Infinite, or Y700 Ultimate, or Y700 Unlimited - machine translation from Chinese isn't very accurate in this case. Either way, it seems to be based on the existing Y700, which launched back in March, but the new device will come with 5G mobile data connectivity built-in. title: Honor's 12,000 mAh battery is now reportedly in "trial production"
description: Honor has, in the past, been rumored to aim for an 11,000 mAh to 12,000 mAh battery for the upcoming Power3, but then it seemed like 10,000 mAh was all it would get. We also heard that the company was developing a 14,000 mAh smartphone battery, but right now it's unclear what happened to that. However, Digital Chat Station now claims that Honor is developing a new 12,000 mAh battery, which has already entered "trial production". 12,000 mAh, of course, is the typical capacity that will be advertised by the brand. title: Huawei Watch GT 7 and GT 7 Pro bring up to 21-day battery life
description: Huawei introduced the Watch GT 7 and Watch GT 7 Pro in China last week alongside the nova 16 SE, the 2026 MateBook Fold, and the 2026 MatePad Pro. The new smartwatches offer modest upgrades over the Watch GT 6 series and are available for purchase in China. The Watch GT 7 comes in 41mm and 46mm case sizes, while the Watch GT 7 Pro is available in a single size. When it comes to design, both smartwatches are similar to their predecessors. title: Claude now watermarks text to indicate that it was generated by AI
description: You may have seen watermarks on AI-generated images to indicate that they were indeed made with AI. Now, even AI-generated text is being watermarked to make it easier for consumers to spot online content and comments that were written by AI. Anthropic, the company behind Claude, has signed the EU’s Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content and explains how text watermarking works. Text watermarks are machine-readable but should be transparent to humans. “When a supported Claude model generates text, it weaves an imperceptible watermark directly into the text itself. You...

description: vivo is expected to launch the X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max next month, and today thanks to a new leak from Digital Chat Station on Weibo, we have some details about their screen sizes and design details, specifically for the camera bumps. description: As expected, Xiaomi unveiled its newest Redmi K-series phones in China today, and they are equipped with some impressive specs. Though they look alike, they also bring several key differences. Redmi K100 Pro (left) and K100 Pro Max (right) Redmi K100 Pro gets Qualcomm’s recently announced Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V Series (SM8850-1-AB) chip, which is a binned version of the regular SD Elite Gen 5. title: The Fairphone 6+ will have an upgraded chipset for slightly higher performance too, leak shows
description: So, there is more to it than more RAM and a new color – the Fairphone 6+ will feature a new chipset too. EvLeaks has posted the complete specs sheet for the upcoming phone, an “exploded view” image of the phone’s internals and even a promo video. Leaked: Fairphone 6+ complete specs sheet The specs sheet helpfully marks the changes from the original Fairphone 6 in bold. As previously reported, the RAM capacity on the Plus model will increase to 12GB, up from 8GB (LPDDR5 in both cases). Storage remains the same, 256GB of UFS 3.1, plus the microSD card slot. description: Apple's first foldable iPhone is expected to debut this September with a design similar to the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 and Huawei Pura X Max. Well-known tipster Ice Universe has shared images and a hands-on video of what is claimed to be the front screen protector of the rumored iPhone Ultra. description: Samsung released the first One UI 9 beta for the Galaxy S26 series in May, and the company recently confirmed that the fifth One UI 9 beta for the lineup will be rolled out this week. While Galaxy S26 series users await the rollout of One UI 9 Beta 5, and of course the stable update, Samsung has reportedly begun working on One UI 9.5 for the S26 lineup. The source also claims that the One UI 9.5 build Samsung is developing for the Galaxy S26 series has a version ending in CZH1, but doesn't provide a timeframe for the release. description: The Google Pixel 11 series is going official tomorrow at the Made by Google event. While most details about the lineup have already leaked, a new rumor has revealed details about the base Pixel 11's telephoto camera. According to tipster @evowizz, the standard Pixel 11 will feature a 10.8MP periscope telephoto camera. It is likely the same sensor used in the Pixel 10 and is expected to support 5x optical zoom. title: YouTube will expand Premium Lite availability, increase requirements for revenue sharing
description: The YouTube Partner Program (YPP) launched two decades ago and now boasts over 3 million creators. However, if you want to join their ranks, you will now have to meet higher requirements than before. That said, if you are already in YPP, you will stay in YPP. For those looking to join, you will need to hit double the metrics of the previous thresholds. For long-form videos, this means 8,000 view hours, up from 4,000 hours. title: FDA approves Samsung's Hearing Aid feature on Galaxy Buds
description: Samsung has been improving its health-tracking features and the recent FDA approval for the Galaxy Buds' Hearing Aid feature adds another such feature to its toolbox. The US Food and Drug Administration cleared the Hearing Aid feature as an over-the-counter (OTC) solution for users aged 18 and above. It makes some Galaxy Buds models a convenient alternative to some expensive hearing aid devices for people with mild to moderate hearing loss. description: Rumors about Apple's all-glass iPhone for the device's 20th anniversary have been circulating for months. However, a recent report claimed that the redesigned model had been cancelled. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman has now disputed that claim, saying the device remains on track. Citing people familiar with the matter, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that Apple is still planning to introduce a glass-centric iPhone design to mark the device's 20th anniversary next year. description: Google will unveil the Pixel 11 series at its Made by Google event tomorrow. Just ahead of the launch, the Pixel 11 Pro XL has appeared on Geekbench, while the Pixel 11 Pro has surfaced in leaked hands-on images. The Geekbench listing has revealed details on Google's Tensor G6 chipset. It has a 7-core CPU with two cores clocked at 2.65GHz, four running at 3.38GHz, and a single prime core reaching 4.11GHz. description: iQOO will introduce the Z11 in India on August 20, and it recently confirmed that the Indian Z11 will be powered by the Dimensity 7500 Turbo SoC, which is different from the processors powering the Chinese and Malaysian Z11. The Indian iQOO Z11 will be fueled by a 7,050 mAh battery and pack a 6.83" curved AMOLED 1.5K resolution display with a 144Hz refresh rate and 3,000 nits peak brightness.
